title: Candidate Interview Approval Form
subtitle: Use this approval to test evidence and authority, resolve conflicts, issue a bounded decision, and verify every resulting update for a candidate interview workflow.
description: An original operational candidate interview approval form that controls a interview stage and candidate record from identity and routing through evidence, qualified decision, exception management, implementation, handoff, and final verification.
use_case: Use when the recruiting coordinator or interview lead needs a traceable approval so the qualified recruiting or HR reviewer can advance, hold, decline, reschedule, or obtain additional job-related evidence under the approved requisition, structured interview plan, privacy rules, and applicable equal-employment requirements without relying on an informal email, spreadsheet, or unreviewed narrative.

sections.title: Candidate Interview approval submission and authority route
sections.guidance: Identify the proposed action, submitter, decision authority, effective point, and required evidence.

blocks.label: Candidate Interview identity
Approval ownership and routing
Approval control
Proposed action, purpose, exact scope, affected people or work, exclusions, and requested conditions

sections.title: Candidate Interview evidence completeness and readiness
sections.guidance: Reject unsupported assumptions before the decision reaches an approver.

blocks.label: Candidate Interview approval readiness
items: Interview need and stage align with the approved hiring process
Assigned interviewers are available, trained, and conflict-free
Questions and exercises are job related and consistently administered
Candidate access or adjustment coordination has an accountable route
Decision rights and scorecard due times are explicit
Data access, note retention, and recording rules are communicated
Schedule gives the candidate and panel a workable preparation window
Any exception has qualified HR review and a documented condition

blocks.label: Evidence package submitted
items: Approved requisition and current position description
Structured question set and scoring anchors
Panel assignment and competency coverage plan
Candidate schedule and delivery confirmation
Individual interview notes and completed scorecard
Work-sample instructions, submission, and evaluator record
Conflict, adjustment, or incident routing reference
Candidate next-step communication and recruiting-system entry

blocks.label: Required item, evidence, owner, status, and deficiency

sections.title: Candidate Interview policy, authority, and impact review
sections.guidance: Apply the current decision standard and record each reviewer within their actual authority.

blocks.label: Candidate Interview policy and impact checks
items: Evidence addresses the stated essential job outcome
Example identifies the candidate's own actions and contribution
Response shows relevant judgment, sequencing, or prioritization
Technical or functional evidence matches the approved question
Communication evidence is assessed against a defined role need
Rating cites observable evidence rather than personality shorthand
Follow-up prompts were consistent and job related
Missing evidence is marked unknown rather than inferred
Panel notes distinguish facts, quotation fragments, and conclusions
Scoring anchors were applied consistently across candidates

blocks.label: Review area, reviewer, authority, evidence, finding, and condition
People, schedule, service, cost, payroll, privacy, security, safety, consistency, and system impacts

sections.title: Candidate Interview conflicts, exceptions, and approval conditions
sections.guidance: Resolve material conflicts and convert every condition into owned, verifiable work.

blocks.label: Approval stop and escalation boundary
blocks.guidance: Pause any action outside documented authority. Protect privacy, preserve the original evidence, and route urgent, safety, security, retaliation, or legal concerns to the qualified recruiting or HR reviewer under the approved requisition, structured interview plan, privacy rules, and applicable equal-employment requirements.

blocks.label: Candidate Interview exception and escalation triggers
items: Inappropriate or non-job-related question was asked
Candidate information reached an unintended recipient
Interview recording occurred without required authorization
Technology failure materially reduced the candidate's opportunity
Panel conflict of interest or prior relationship was disclosed
Approved interview questions or scoring anchors were not used
Candidate reported harassment, bias, retaliation, or unsafe conduct
Work sample, notes, or scorecard was lost, altered, or misattributed

blocks.label: Exception, immediate action, owner, due point, and disposition register
Exception facts, affected scope, privacy boundary, unresolved risk, and escalation rationale
Approval condition, prerequisite, owner, due point, evidence, and expiry

sections.title: Candidate Interview approval decision and effective boundary
sections.guidance: Record one unambiguous decision with rationale, authority, conditions, and review date.

blocks.label: Approval boundary
blocks.guidance: Approval is valid only within the stated scope and authority. The qualified recruiting or HR reviewer must apply the approved requisition, structured interview plan, privacy rules, and applicable equal-employment requirements; a signature does not override a required privacy, safety, security, legal, payroll, tax, or accommodation review.

blocks.label: Approval decision
Evidence relied upon, contrary evidence, alternatives, conditions, limits, and reason for decision
Submission, qualified review, and decision authorization

fields.label: Qualified Recruiting Or Hr Reviewer / date

sections.title: Candidate Interview implementation, notification, and approval closeout
sections.guidance: Verify that the approved outcome reached every affected system and recipient.

blocks.label: Approved implementation, system update, notification, and verification
Approval outcome and handoff
Open candidate interview action and limitation register
Closeout and recipient handoff confirmations
items: Final decision and effective boundary are recorded
Evidence supporting the outcome is linked and readable
Every unresolved action has an owner and due point
Sensitive information is routed only to the designated restricted record
Affected people and receiving systems received the necessary status
Conditions, limitations, and escalation triggers remain visible
Required payroll, schedule, access, asset, or workflow update is confirmed
Follow-up review or reopen condition has an accountable owner

blocks.label: Final evidence, decision rationale, remaining limitation, communication, and acceptance
Approval accountable review

fields.label: Qualified Recruiting Or Hr Reviewer / date
